canada.title: Researchers pause efforts to coax orcas out of basin near Prince Rupert
canada.summary: Fisheries and Oceans Canada and marine researchers are monitoring two killer whales in Wainwright Basin south of Prince Rupert. The whales responded to recordings of calls from their pod but efforts to get them to leave have so far not worked.

canada.summary: Budget committee met on Tuesday to start the budget process for 2027-2028.

canada.title: Aurora College intends to offer social work, education programs in fall 2027
canada.summary: Two programs once offered by Aurora College and suspended a decade ago in the face of strong public objections are expected to be among offerings next fall — but college leadership say they will be different.

canada.title: 1 man dead after shooting, attempted home invasion in midtown Toronto: police
canada.summary: A man has died after a shooting during an attempted home invasion early Wednesday in Toronto, police say.

canada.title: Lack of snow forces cancellation of World Cup giant slalom races in Quebec
canada.summary: Two women's World Cup giant slalom races scheduled in Mont-Tremblant, Que., have been cancelled due to a lack of snow, the International Ski and Snowboard Federation says.

canada.summary: Natural resources and economic development committee met Tuesday to discuss development of Nova Scotia's offshore wind and alternative energy.

canada.title: Heavy rains, storm surge, high tides cause ‘real drama’ along B.C.’s coast
canada.summary: British Columbia's coast is getting another weather wallop as Environment Canada warns of rain of up to 225 millimetres along much of the coast before the end of the day.

canada.title: Former Alberta justice minister Kaycee Madu cleared of professional misconduct
canada.summary: Kaycee Madu has had his professional misconduct finding quashed in a case that accused him of calling Edmonton's police chief to get out of a distracted driving ticket.

canada.title: Driver in 2025 crash that killed Ontario father of 3 expected to be sentenced
canada.summary: Jaiwin Kirubananthan pleaded guilty to five charges, including dangerous driving causing death, in the August 2025 crash that killed 35-year-old Andrew Cristillo.

canada.title: Central Edmonton tenants forced to leave their apartments due to unsafe building conditions
canada.summary: Social service agencies and city officials are working to help tenants who were legally ordered to pack up their lives after their apartment building was deemed unsafe by a judge.

canada.title: Montreal's tax hike is making headlines, but here are other takeaways from the budget
canada.summary: The tax hike is a big deal and represents a broken promise by the mayor during last year’s election campaign. It also may be distracting you from other key elements of this budget. Tax increase aside, here are some takeaways.

canada.title: Parks Canada worker in Yukon says trail maintenance already suffering, ahead of job cuts
canada.summary: Ryan Colpitts, a Parks Canada trail worker at Kluane National Park and Reserve in the Yukon, says maintenance in the park is already falling behind – and he fears federal workforce cuts could make it harder to keep visitors to the park safe.

canada.title: ​Shop owners say people are 'desensitized' to the conditions in Saskatoon's core
canada.summary: Saskatoon business owners say constantly witnessing the fallout of drug use, mental health issues and violence in Saskatoon's core area is taking a toll, and that growing encampments are making it worse.

canada.title: After torturing victim over missing drugs, Saskatoon man played VLTs, stabbed a stranger
canada.summary: Within hours of participating in a brutally violent homicide, Dillon Singler went out and played some VLTs at Market Mall in Saskatoon, where he randomly attacked and stabbed another man.

canada.title: Steinbach software developer uses AI to help people make voting choices, follow local government
canada.summary: A software developer in Steinbach has developed a website that uses AI to comb through online local government sources to help himself, and others, make voting decisions. But some raise concerns about AI's role in the democratic process.

canada.title: Selkirk volunteer hopes federal funds for homelessness make their way to Manitoba city
canada.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced $1 billion in funding to tackle homelessness while in Winnipeg earlier this month. Volunteers are hoping a fair chunk of that money will flow to other Manitoba communities.

canada.title: Witnesses, video reveal details of police response that ended with man’s death
canada.summary: Some residents of Murray Avenue in Fredericton are questioning how a response by police to a disturbance complaint ended with a neighbour's home going up in flames and the neighbour dying.

canada.title: 'It's my dream': Sussex parents eager for francophone school to be built
canada.summary: Some parents living in Sussex say a francophone school the province plans to build in the area is highly-anticipated and will help solidify the presence of a growing community of French speakers in the area.
